source: Not a book section. The module shape (build the mechanic, then the obstacles, then the score, then the end, then a check) follows CodeHS's project modules in Introduction to Game Design, with the array rollout taken from AP CSP's lists module. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Plan, and the flap
lessons.objective: Students will be able to plan a game as parts and remembered values, make a sprite fall under gravity, and lift it by one sudden change of speed on a key tap.

lessons.title: A world that scrolls
lessons.objective: Students will be able to build obstacles on a timer, keep them in an array, and delete the ones that have left.

lessons.title: Score and crash
lessons.objective: Students will be able to count each obstacle once, end the round on a crash, and put back everything a round owns.

lessons.title: Playtest, check, and make it yours
lessons.objective: Students will be able to playtest their own game, link what they saw to their code, check their understanding of the flapping game, and extend it with a rule of their own.
